songs.title: Neon Odyssey
lyrics: When the long working day uptown is over
All the subway lines wrap around the world
I carry myself up the stairs and pull the covers closer
Chasing the dream that I might find myself again
When a memory is a time machine
Whispers quiet but defiantly
It’s time to leave
When a memory is a time machine
Fly you on its wings from your history
To what might yet be a reason to believe
It’s out beyond the breakers
It’s waiting for the takers on the edge of day
The golden gleam before it fades away
On the outer edge of inner space
The gaze of a familiar face in front of me
Reminds a neon odyssey awaits
In the cracks another skyline waits to open
For a second you can see the seams appear
Is it a trick of light or a dare to raise the curtain
Or a cave to enter just to face your fears
I know a neon odyssey awaits
I know a neon odyssey awaits
